minutes.headline: ZBA granted variances for a Kimble Street deck and a large ground-mounted solar array on Malpus Road.
minutes.summary: The Zoning Board of Appeals heard two dimensional-variance/special-permit requests: a modest deck addition at 12 Kimble Street needing relief from the front-yard setback, and a much larger 18.9 kW ground-mounted solar array at 560 Malpus Road needing relief from the 200-foot setback required near a conservation district. Both were granted as presented, with the solar project still required to go before the Planning Board and Conservation Commission for further review.

what_happened.line: ZBA granted a special permit and dimensional variance for a large ground-mounted solar array at 560 Malpus Road, allowing it well inside the setback normally required near a conservation district.
The board noted the solar project still must go before the Planning Board and Conservation Commission before it can be built.
ZBA separately granted a front-yard setback variance for a deck addition at 12 Kimble Street.
An abutter raised concerns about silt fencing near Malpus Brook and the visual impact of tree clearing for the solar array.

why_it_matters: A neighboring property owner near Malpus Road will see further review at Planning Board and Conservation Commission before any construction, so the setback relief granted tonight is not the final word.
The variance sets a precedent for how close a ground-mounted solar array can sit to a conservation district, which could matter to other residents proposing similar projects.
The Kimble Street deck variance affects only that one property's front-yard setback and carries the board's standard special-permit conditions.
